class.name: SnowClumps3D
class.brief_description: Lumps of snow that boots, wheels and sleds break out of cohesive snow and leave beside their prints.
class.description: Watches the print field of a [SnowSurface3D] round the camera. Where a rim grows (snow pushed up and out of a print), a share of the pushed volume ([member break_share]) breaks into clumps when the pack is cohesive: settled or moist snow sinters into lumps that hold together, cold new powder sprays and leaves none (Colbeck 1982; Sumner, O'Brien and Hodgins 1999). Clump sizes are log-normal, larger in wet snow (avalanche debris granules, Bartelt and McArdell 2009). Each clump is thrown a little away from the print, rests on the snow, shrinks in a thaw (degree days), is buried by new snow, and is crushed by a later print that presses or heaps over it. Drawn as one of a few shared lumpy shapes with a fracture face; the path tracer instances them ([method RenderingServer.multimesh_set_rt_instanced]), so it sees every clump. [SnowSurface3D] makes one as an internal child while its [member SnowSurface3D.clumps] is on (the default).

method.name: cohesion
method.description: Returns how readily pushed snow holds together as lumps, 0 to 1, from the pack's [param density] (kg/m³), [param wetness] (0 to 1) and the air [param temperature] (°C).

method.name: get_clump_count
method.description: Returns the number of clumps lying now.

method.name: get_parked_count
method.description: Returns the number of clumps kept while the camera is away from where they lie (in memory; on disk ones are not counted), given back when the print field comes over them again.

method.name: get_spawned_total
method.description: Returns the number of clumps broken off since the node entered the tree.

method.name: get_update_msec_mean
method.description: Returns the mean main-thread time of an update so far, in milliseconds.

method.name: get_update_msec_worst
method.description: Returns the longest main-thread time of an update so far, in milliseconds.

method.name: get_update_runs
method.description: Returns the number of updates so far.

method.name: update_now
method.description: Scans the print field, ages the clumps and draws them now, instead of waiting for the next update (six a second). For tests and tools.

members.member: Of the snow pushed into a rim, the share that breaks into clumps in fully cohesive snow.
If [code]false[/code], no clumps break off and those lying are removed.
The clumps' material. By default a white, rough snow.
The most clumps lying at once; past it the oldest are replaced.
Distance round the camera, in metres, within which new rims break into clumps.
Seed for the clumps' sizes, shapes and places.
The [SnowSurface3D] whose prints are watched. If empty, the parent.
